scope: Observed tail trial wheel-body relation and yield decisions, using the same retained source pins.

protocol.sensor_configuration: Stock five-camera surround body and rig, 1280x720 native front optical image, exact control crop of native 100 m lidar and all five native radar sensors; normal episode policy.
protocol.omitted: Chase movie and the rider-only YOLOX/SurroundPerception pass. RGB NanoDet, map/route, lamp, LiDAR and radar control paths are unmodified.

measure: Native body polygon projected onto the navigable forward station. Velocity estimates are directional 0.5 s poses. A four-second comparative gain is shown when both source and alternate forward vehicles are measured. This does not alter the preregistered zero occupied-gap grade.
